retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, surrealist collage featuring a central skull with a clock eye and hardware elements against a saturated purple and blue twilight sky.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central human skull wearing a red cap, featuring a clock face in the left eye socket and a large metal screw piercing through the head. The skull is supported by skeletal arm bones over a dark, textured ground, set against a dramatic purple and blue sky with low-lying clouds.
coreVisualRelationships: Skull centered as the primary focal point
Clock face nested within the eye socket
Screw diagonally bisecting the skull structure
Skeletal limbs forming a base at the bottom center
Text layered across the top and bottom corners
coreInvariants: Large metal screw as a structural element
Heavy drop shadows on all typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central skull occupying the middle 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The skull's nasal cavity and teeth provide a dark, high-contrast center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large top text, down through the clock eye, following the screw to the skeletal base, ending at the bottom-left text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense central composition with open sky in the upper corners and dark ground at the bottom.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and navy blue sky background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bone white and ochre for the skull and skeletal elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow and bright blue for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky and text; high value contrast on the skull highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Top line uses high-contrast, thin-serif capitals
Middle line uses heavy, italicized, blocky sans-serif
Bottom line uses ultra-bold, condensed slab-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Yellow text features a slight horizontal shear for speed effect
Blue bottom text features an inner bevel effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif paired with aggressive, slanted sans-serif for a 'street' vs 'classic' tension.

preserve: Yellow color for the slanted text
The contrast between thin serif and thick sans-serif

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast thin serif of the top line
Matches the heavy, slanted weight of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal digital collage of a human skull with a clock face in one eye and a metal screw through the temple, set against a vibrant purple and blue twilight sky with skeletal arms at the base.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply white high-contrast serif text at the top with a heavy drop shadow. Add a second line of bold yellow italicized sans-serif text below it. Place a blocky blue slab-serif text in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the clock face visible in the eye socket?
Is the sky a saturated purple/blue gradient?
Does the typography have heavy black drop shadows?
Is the skull the central focal point?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text drop shadows are prominent
Confirm skull is wearing a red cap
recipe.reuseFormula: Central surreal object + hardware/mechanical integration + saturated twilight sky + multi-font heavy-shadowed typography.
